title: Life Is Happening For You
script_text:
Anything that annoys you, teaches patience.
Anyone who abandons you, teaches strength.
Anything that angers you, teaches forgiveness.
Anything you fear, teaches courage.
Anything you can't control, teaches surrender.
Life isn't happening to you.
It's happening for you.

title: Losing You Is My Biggest Fear
script_text:
I never want to lose you, because I can't imagine a world without you.
You came into my life in a way I never expected.
You became such a special part of my world.
I can't explain how much you mean to me.
No matter how strong I try to be, the thought of losing you breaks my heart from the inside.

title: You Loved Me Anyway
script_text:
When I thought I didn't deserve love, you loved me anyway.
When all I knew was darkness, you brought me light.
When I said I was broken, you healed things you didn't break.
When I struggled to love myself, you loved me quietly.

title: If I Could Give You The World
script_text:
If I could give you the world,
it still wouldn't match what you've given me.
You're the one decision I'd make a thousand times over, without a second thought.
Even time itself can't take this love from us,
even if it speeds up, slows down, or reverses itself.
You're always there with me.
You are the kind of beauty that artists dream of capturing.
If fate exists, it showed up in my life as you.
Knowing you're here is enough to make this complicated life feel beautifully simple again.
Tough days become something I don't dwell on.
And every moment I love is something that stays with me forever.

title: Born Again
script_text:
After you walked away from me, I didn't break.
I learned to forget you.
I learned how to live without you.
And I began to love myself.
In the end, I was able to start over and begin a new life.

title: Some People Were Only Sent To Teach You
script_text:
When someone isn't right for you, life will keep using them to hurt you, until you're strong enough to let go.
And one day you'll realize,
they were only sent to teach you that losing someone is how you find yourself.

title: The People Meant For Us Feel Exactly Like You
script_text:
The people meant for us feel exactly like you,
someone I've always known,
someone who never expects me to be anything more than myself.
You're the person I hoped would arrive,
but never knew how to find.

title: The Hardest Lesson I've Learned As An Adult
script_text:
The hardest lesson I've learned as an adult is that life doesn't stop, even when you're hurt.
No matter the pain, exhaustion, or loss, you still have to push through.
We grow up expecting happy endings, but find ourselves pretending to be okay instead.
Yet through it all, we find a strength we never knew we had.

title: The Best Decision I Ever Made
script_text:
The best decision I ever made was to be quiet.
I have nothing to prove.
I'm not convincing anyone that I'm a great person.
I'm not fixing what I didn't break.
I'm not fighting for anyone to see my worth.
Whatever you do is on you.
Just make sure the choices you make today are ones you can live with tomorrow.

title: You Are The Love That Came At The Perfect Moment
script_text:
You are the love that came at the perfect moment.
They say timing is everything,
and I can't imagine if the moment our eyes met never existed.
You give everything new passion.
You don't sway when things happen.
You're the clearest proof that true love doesn't rush,
it waits until we're ready.
And now, right here,
I finally understand why love took its time,
because every second of waiting was leading me to you.

title: Life Gets Easier When You Stop Fighting It
script_text:
Life gets easier when you stop fighting it.
The rain will fall whether you complain or not.
Traffic will exist whether you stress or not.
People will act how they want whether you worry or not.
Focus on what you can change.
Let go of what you can't change.

title: Thank You For Loving Me
script_text:
Thank you for loving me.
You bring happiness into my life in ways I can't put into words.
I wish you knew how much our little talks and the time we spend together mean to me.
Every moment with you feels like a gift I never want to let go of.
I'm grateful every day for someone like you in my life.

title: What Love Feels Like
script_text:
If someone asked me what love feels like, I'd simply point to us.
With you, love isn't just a feeling.
It's the way time forgets to move when we're together.
It's the way my heart finds its way home in your presence.
And the way every dream I've quietly held somehow made room for you.

title: I Remember The Day We First Met
script_text:
I remember the day we first met.
I remember the way everything around me went silent.
I remember how it felt like time didn't exist for a while,
because of how we spoke, as if we already knew each other.

title: Be Yourself
script_text:
The moon doesn't compare itself to the stars.
The flowers don't compare themselves to other flowers.
We shouldn't compare ourselves to anyone else either.
So just be yourself.
Walk your own path quietly, and life becomes so much easier.

title: What Is Love
script_text:
What is love?
After all, it's quite simple.
Love is everything that enhances, widens, and enriches our life.
In its heights and in its depths, it makes every moment worth living.

title: My Love For You Is Immutable
script_text:
If you asked me if I love you, I'd say yes.
But if you asked me again, I'd say my love for you is immutable.
It's in the way I can't stop thinking about you, even when I'm busy,
or how you listen to me ramble about nothing and everything.
It's how everything is better when you're a part of it,
and how I feel complete when I'm with you, and lost when I'm not.
I would tell you that I love you like deep conversations,
like rooftop views,
or the moments we steal away from the world and make our own.
And I would tell you how even a look from you
sends shivers down my spine,
or how I love the way your voice softens when you say my name.
To love you is to love the layers of your history that have shaped you,
and every new layer still to come.
It's to taste new beginnings, and to dream of a thousand tomorrows.

title: Thank You For Being Such An Amazing Friend
script_text:
Thank you for being such an amazing friend, the kind I could never have asked for.
Thank you for listening to my stories and my random rants.
Thank you for always being there when I needed someone to talk to.
I'm so lucky to have a friend like you.
Just remember, I'm always here if you ever need a shoulder to lean on.

title: Trust The Process
script_text:
Sometimes the timing isn't ours to control.
But when you trust the process,
you allow the universe to guide you exactly where you're meant to be.
Every detail, every delay, it's all shaping you for something greater.
One day, you'll look back and realize, it had to happen this way.
Trust the timing, trust your growth, trust the journey.

title: A Gentle Reminder For Your Day
script_text:
Just a reminder:
doing your best doesn't mean pushing yourself until you break down.
The goal is to keep going,
not to prove how much you can carry.

title: People Will Be Who They Are
script_text:
I used to believe that if I treated people with kindness, they'd return it.
But life taught me otherwise.
People will be who they are, believe what they want, and act however they choose,
regardless of how it affects you.
At the end of the day, actions speak the loudest and words often mean the least.

title: I'll Always Find My Way To You
script_text:
I still hope it's you and me in the end.
My heart cannot imagine a world without you.
No matter how many years pass without us seeing each other, or how much distance stands between us,
even if the universe itself tries to keep us apart,
I will always find my way back to you.

title: Why Do They Hurt Me
script_text:
I spent so much time trying to understand why people hurt me.
I kept searching for reasons for their distance, their inconsistency.
The way they could walk away so easily without looking back.
But eventually I realized, I was giving kindness to people who never noticed how deeply they were breaking my heart.

title: You Are The Reason I Believe In Love Again
script_text:
You are the reason I stopped waiting for something bigger to happen.
You are the moment I realized it already had.

title: I Wish You The Absolute Best
script_text:
I wish you happiness always, wherever you may be.
Even if life takes you far away from me, your presence will remain in my heart forever, unchanged.
You are no longer with me, but I still wish nothing but the very best for you.
The time we spent together has become only a memory,
but I'm so grateful someone like you was part of my life, even if only for a season.

title: My Soul Yearns For A Soul Like My Own
script_text:
My soul yearns for a soul like my own.
In this crowded world, that might be the hardest thing to find.
Someone who carries a heart full of understanding,
and still knows what it means to feel alone.
Someone who understands the way I love.

title: All That I Am Belongs To You
script_text:
We say, I'm all yours.
But the soul says, every choice leads me back to you.
All that I am, and all that I hope to be, belongs to you.

title: Choose Your Peace
script_text:
At some point, you will have to disappoint others to live a life that's honest to you.
People-pleasing will drain you, not save you.
You have every right to set boundaries and choose your peace.
You can disappoint people and still be a good person.

title: Questions For Your Mother
script_text:
Five questions to ask your mother while you still can.
What did you want to become before you had me?
What's a moment you're quietly proud of me for?
What's something you gave up for us that we never noticed?
And what's one thing you want me to always remember, after you're gone?

title: I Used Everything You Gave Me
script_text:
I read a quote that said, When I stand before God at the end of my life,
I would hope that I would not have a single bit of talent left and could say,
I used everything you gave me, and I hope one day I can honestly say the same.

title: You Can Talk To Me About Anything
script_text:
You can talk to me about anything.
You can feel safe with me through anything.
You can let your tears fall on my shoulder, and let your worries go.
I'll listen without trying to fix you.
I'll hold you without crowding your space.
I want to be someone who makes breathing easier,
someone who makes you forget the heaviness of what came before.
I don't promise perfection.
Just honesty, and the kind of love you never doubt.

title: What Is Meant For You Cannot Pass You By
script_text:
What's meant for you cannot pass you by.
You are not late, you are not behind.
You can't lose what already belongs to your path.
Trust the timing, release what no longer fits.
Follow what feels true.
What is aligned will find you exactly when you're ready.

title: Always Love You
script_text:
For every day I miss you.
For every hour I need you.
For every minute I feel you.
For every second I want you.
Forever, I love you.

title: Soulmates Recognize Each Other
script_text:
They say soulmates recognize each other instantly.
And I think that's why I felt so comfortable from the start.
I didn't need time to understand how much you meant to me.
Because my heart already knew, and it always did.

title: I Just Wanted To Say
script_text:
I just wanted to say,
you became someone who reminded me how it feels to truly live again.
I didn't realize how closed my heart had become,
until you walked into my life,
helping me remember who I was beneath all the heaviness.
You stayed with me through moments I couldn't fully explain,
and the comfort you've given me is enough to keep me believing
in possibilities, in hope,
and in something greater than myself.
I probably don't tell you enough,
but when you came along,
I felt something in me shift back into place,
like my heart had finally remembered how to beat again.

title: Not Limited To This Lifetime
script_text:
Maybe it's okay that I lost you in this life.
But I still keep hoping that somewhere in another lifetime, I'll find you again.
And in that lifetime, I'll never let you go.
We'll hold hands and walk together in peace,
never to be parted again.

title: The Heart Needs More Time
script_text:
Sometimes the heart needs more time to accept what the mind already knows.
The mind moves on the day it understands.
The heart moves on the day it stops hoping.
And between those two days, a person lives an entire life, pretending to be fine.

title: I Spent Too Much Time Trying To Become Easier
script_text:
I spent too much time trying to become easier.
Easier to understand.

title: Accept People As They Are
script_text:
Accept people as they are. Place them where they belong.
You are responsible for your own life.
Acceptance frees you from trying to change anyone.
Boundaries protect your peace.
Not everyone earns the same access, the same closeness, or the same seat at your table.
And that's not cruelty. That's self-respect.

title: He Was Just Doing His Best
script_text:
As you grow older, you begin to understand.
Your father was just a man, trying his best with what he knew.
He put your needs before his own.
He traded some of his dreams for the dreams he had for you.
He was living life for the first time too.

title: Some Things Must End
script_text:
If you keep carrying old bricks, you'll keep building the same house.
New doors cannot open in rooms you never leave.
New chapters cannot begin, while you're still rereading the last page.
Tomorrow cannot arrive, while you're living in yesterday.
Some things must end, so better things can begin.

title: Some People Do More Than Pass Through Your Life
script_text:
Some people do more than pass through your life.
They become the person you keep choosing,
the person you keep showing up for,
the person you would rearrange plans and dreams around,
just because you believe in them so much.
And you notice it in the choices you make without even thinking about it.
It's the first person you think of calling when you need someone to talk to,
whose opinion you want before you make final decisions,
who becomes part of how you picture the future,
the one you think about even in a room full of people.
That's when you realize being around them is never a waste of time,
because they add something to you.
And no matter how much of them you get, some part of you still wants more.

title: The Best Decision I Ever Made
script_text:
The best decision I ever made was to be quiet.
I have nothing to prove.
I'm not convincing anyone that I'm a great person.
I'm not fixing what I didn't break.
I'm not fighting for anyone to see my worth.
Whatever you do is on you.
Just make sure the choices you make today are ones you can live with tomorrow.

title: The Right Person
script_text:
I read somewhere that the right person won't leave you.
No matter how hard things get, they'll stay by your side.
They don't need perfect timing or easy days to prove it.
They just need you.
And honestly, that makes so much sense.

title: A Love That Feels Real
script_text:
I don't need a perfect relationship.
I just want one that feels real and safe.
No lies, no cheating, no breaking up over every little fight.
If we argue, we talk it through. If life gets hard, we face it together.
We don't walk away. We stay. That's the kind of love I want.

title: I'm Grateful For You
script_text:
I'm grateful for you, for us, for now.
When I picture happiness, it's your face that I see first.
You won't always see yourself the way I do,
but I'll remind you until you do.
And if I had one wish,
it would be to always be the one who does.

title: Enough Playing
script_text:
Half of life is lost charming others.
The other half is lost in the anxieties they cause.
Leave this play.
You've played enough.

title: As Adults We Understand Villains
script_text:
As kids, we love the heroes.
But as adults, we understand the villains.
Life teaches us that people aren't simply good or bad.
Sometimes the villain is just someone who got tired of being hurt,
someone who stopped explaining themselves, someone who finally chose themselves after being forgotten.

title: Home Is Wherever We Are Together
script_text:
Thank you for finding me.
I promise this to you, my love:
within my arms, you shall find your home.
Until we see each other again,
know that you dwell in my heart.
That's where I will keep you,
until the day we never have to part.

title: Some People Were Only Sent To Teach You
script_text:
When someone isn't right for you, life will keep using them to hurt you, until you're strong enough to let go.
And one day you'll realize,
they were only sent to teach you that losing someone is how you find yourself.

title: Find Your Happy Place
script_text:
In the wrong place, even your very best will never feel like enough.
But in the right place, your mere presence will be celebrated.
The same person can feel ordinary in one place, and extraordinary in another.

title: Loyalty Ends When Benefits Stop
script_text:
Once the rain is over, an umbrella becomes a burden to everyone, the day a blind man sees,
the first thing he throws away is the stick that helped him all his life.
When the sun returns,
the first thing they extinguish is the candle that guided them through the dark.
That's how loyalty ends when benefits stop.

title: Love Finds You Unexpectedly
script_text:
When you fall in love with someone you never expected to fall for,
that is the most beautiful kind of love.
It catches you off guard, turns your world upside down, yet feels right anyway.
There is no expectation, just raw, unfiltered emotion.
It's almost like it starts off as a secret,
but then suddenly it's the only love that fills your mind.
Then you finally realize true love doesn't have to be chased,
because love finds you when you least expect it,
and there's no other love like that.

title: Trust The Process
script_text:
Sometimes the timing isn't ours to control.
But when you trust the process,
you allow the universe to guide you exactly where you're meant to be.
Every detail, every delay, it's all shaping you for something greater.
One day, you'll look back and realize, it had to happen this way.
Trust the timing, trust your growth, trust the journey.

title: Transformation
script_text:
When the right person enters your life, it's not just love, it's transformation.
They don't bring confusion or chaos. They bring calm.
They don't focus on your past. They see the strength in your scars.
They inspire you to heal and to grow.
It's not just a relationship. It's a partnership in becoming your best self.

title: We Deserve This
script_text:
This chapter of our story is called, we deserve this.
Life hasn't been gentle to either of us, and we've both carried scars from choices we once made.
But somehow, life still brought us to each other for a reason.
Now we're learning what real love feels like.
So when you see us smiling, let us smile. We deserve this.

title: The Kind Of Love That Lets Your Mind Rest
script_text:
I will love you today, tomorrow, every day that comes,
and every day that has already passed.
I will love you through happiness,
and I will love you through trials.
You will never, ever have to second-guess my love for you.

title: I Like You vs I Love You
script_text:
What's the difference between I like you and I love you?
If you like a flower, you pick it.
If you love a flower, you care for it, water it daily, and protect it.
That's the difference between liking and loving.
And when you truly understand that difference, you understand life.

title: I'm Just Kinder To Myself
script_text:
I don't chase people anymore. I chase peace.
If you stay, I'm grateful. If you leave, I'm still peaceful.
Because I finally learned, my worth isn't proven by how hard I'm willing to suffer to be loved.
I'm not cold.
I'm just kinder to myself.

title: Your Flaws Do Not Scare Me
script_text:
You don't have to pretend around me.
I want you to know that your flaws do not scare me.
They remind me you are human, and that is who I love.
I want you to remember that you are enough,
even on the days you feel like less.
I would choose your shadows over anyone else's light.

title: The Hardest Lesson I've Learned As An Adult
script_text:
The hardest lesson I've learned as an adult is that life doesn't stop, even when you're hurt.
No matter the pain, exhaustion, or loss, you still have to push through.
We grow up expecting happy endings, but find ourselves pretending to be okay instead.
Yet through it all, we find a strength we never knew we had.

title: Fluent In Hiding What I Feel
script_text:
Because I carry it well, doesn't mean it's not heavy.
I've simply become fluent in the language of pretending nothing hurts, when everything does.
I make it look effortless,
because falling apart was never an option.

title: The Hardest Battles We Fight
script_text:
One of the hardest battles we fight is between what we know and what we feel.
The truth may be simple, but feelings have never obeyed logic.
That's what makes being human so difficult.

title: Don't Edit Your Own Soul
script_text:
Franz Kafka said:
it's paradoxical —
by believing passionately in something that still does not exist, we create it.
The non-existent is what we have not sufficiently desired.
Start with what is right, rather than what is acceptable.
Don't bend, don't water it down, don't try to make it logical.
Don't edit your own soul.
From a certain point onward, there is no longer any turning back.
That is the point that must be reached.

title: I Used Everything You Gave Me
script_text:
I read a quote that said, When I stand before God at the end of my life,
I would hope that I would not have a single bit of talent left and could say,
I used everything you gave me, and I hope one day I can honestly say the same.

title: Real Love Is Rare
script_text:
Do you know why real love is rare?
Because it's tested by distance, by miscommunication, by timing, by life.
But if two souls still choose each other, again and again, despite the chaos,
that's not just love.
That's unbreakable.

title: Let Me Remind You
script_text:
Let me remind you, I never want to lose you.
Life feels softer, brighter, and more beautiful with you in it.
You became the kind of person my heart feels safe with.
What I feel for you could never be explained with simple words.
No matter what life puts us through, I hope we always find our way back to each other.

title: You Deserve To Be Chosen Without Asking Twice
script_text:
You deserve to be chosen without having to shrink for it,
without chasing, without proving that you're worth staying for.
Real love won't make you beg,
and won't punish you for your sensitivity, or confuse you with silence.
You won't have to wonder if you're too much or not enough,
because the right person will see your depth, and meet you there.
They'll choose you clearly,
not out of convenience or guilt, but out of knowing your worth, knowing your light.
So stop chasing what doesn't see you.
You are not meant to beg for the very things you were born to receive freely:
love, effort, presence.
You deserve to be chosen without asking twice.

title: Next Life
script_text:
I'm lucky because I found you, because I got to know the real you.
I can't imagine a world where you belong to someone else.
Please, let's never become strangers.
May the hands we're holding today never let go throughout this journey.
And even in the lives beyond this one, I hope I meet you again.

title: Remember The Lesson
script_text:
Forget the past, but remember the lesson.
Let go of what hurts you, but never forget what it taught you.
Not every loss is a failure. Some are just directions.
Learn from it. But don't let it define you.

title: The Universe Won't Give You Peace In What You Weren't Meant To Settle In
script_text:
I read a quote that said,
the universe will never give you peace in something you were never meant to settle in.
And that makes so much sense.

title: Keep Building, Someone Is Waiting
script_text:
No matter how isolated or lonely you feel,
keep doing your work with honesty and quiet dedication.
Some battles are meant to be fought alone. Some chapters can only be written alone.
Someone out there is waiting to meet the person you're becoming.

title: People Take Time, People Change Slowly
script_text:
You won't always get to be the person you wish you were.
There will be days when you fall short of your own expectations,
and some days, old habits will feel closer than the progress you worked so hard to build.
None of that erases the progress you've made.
You are not a puzzle to solve. You are a person to learn.
And people take time. People change slowly.
People get things wrong, and keep going.
Being a work in progress has never disqualified you from being enough right now.

title: Some Things Must End
script_text:
If you keep carrying old bricks, you'll keep building the same house.
New doors cannot open in rooms you never leave.
New chapters cannot begin, while you're still rereading the last page.
Tomorrow cannot arrive, while you're living in yesterday.
Some things must end, so better things can begin.

title: Solitude
script_text:
A day will come when you stop chasing validation.
You stop explaining yourself, stop entertaining chaos.
And you start craving calm and peace instead.
On that day, you'll realize silence heals more than conversation ever did.
And solitude won't scare you anymore. It will feel like home.

title: Drawn To You
script_text:
I got addicted to you so quietly, drawn to you in ways I still can't explain.
Every single day, you're in my mind.
When night falls and the world turns quiet, my mind doesn't.
It fills with thoughts of you.
You're the last wish hidden inside my heart.

title: You Have My Attention, All Of It
script_text:
You have my attention, all of it.
You're the reason I stopped rushing through my days.
Now I notice how the light moves across the wall,
how the air feels different after rain.
You don't have to do anything for me to love you.
Just be here, exactly how you are right now.
I don't know what tomorrow looks like,
but if it has you in it, that's already enough for me.

title: Until The Very End
script_text:
I want to see you win.
I want to see you achieve everything you aim for.
I want to be your biggest supporter, the one who protects you.
I want to be the one you need most in your hardest moments.
I want to walk with you all the way to the very end.

title: Change What Surrounds You
script_text:
I read once that you can't always change the people around you,
but you can change who you choose to be around.
And when I finally understood that,
everything made sense.

title: You Are Part Of My Existence, Part Of Myself
script_text:
You are part of my existence, part of myself.
I love you against reason, against promise,
against peace, against hope, against happiness,
against all discouragement that could be.
And for anyone dear to you, I would do anything.
I wish you to know that you have been the last dream of my soul.

title: Thank You For Being Such An Amazing Friend
script_text:
Thank you for being such an amazing friend, the kind I could never have asked for.
Thank you for listening to my stories and my random rants.
Thank you for always being there when I needed someone to talk to.
I'm so lucky to have a friend like you.
Just remember, I'm always here if you ever need a shoulder to lean on.

title: You Might Already Be Too Late
script_text:
I was too tired to explain, so I chose silence.
You kept asking what was wrong. I kept saying nothing.
You heard my words. You never heard my silence.
You wanted an explanation. I wanted to be understood.
By the time you finally understand me, it might already be too late.

title: Let People Be Exactly Who They Are
script_text:
The beginning of love is letting people be exactly who they are, not shaping them,
not fixing them into a version that makes us comfortable.
Because the moment we try to remake someone in our own image,
we stop loving them for who they are,
and start loving only the reflection of ourselves we see in them.
Real love doesn't demand a transformation.
It offers acceptance.

title: Take Care Of Yourself As Much As You Do Everyone Else
script_text:
In case you forgot what it costs:
people call you difficult when what they really mean is you're no longer easy to use.
Don't let someone praise your kindness while feeding off your lack of boundaries.
Nothing will change until you get tired of being generous,
with people who are careless with you.
One of the biggest signs of taking care of yourself
is how you respond to your own discomfort.
Your sense of self-worth changes,
when you stop treating your instincts like a small thing.

title: Loyalty Ends When Benefits Stop
script_text:
Once the rain is over, an umbrella becomes a burden to everyone, the day a blind man sees,
the first thing he throws away is the stick that helped him all his life.
When the sun returns,
the first thing they extinguish is the candle that guided them through the dark.
That's how loyalty ends when benefits stop.

title: Devotion
script_text:
If someone loves you for your looks, it's obsession.
If someone loves you for your status or what you have, it's attraction.
If someone loves you for your essence, it's affection.
But if someone loves you for who you truly are,
it's devotion.

title: Losing Everything
script_text:
If you feel like you're losing everything, remember.
Trees lose their leaves every year, yet they still stand there.
Waiting quietly for better days to come.
So if life feels empty right now, maybe you're just making space.
For something beautiful to grow again.

title: Some People Just Have This Natural Warmth About Them
script_text:
Some people just have this natural warmth about them,
a kind of light that shines through in anything they do.
You can sense it from the moment you meet them:
the way they listen, the way they smile,
how they seem to care about everyone around them.
It's like they don't even have to try. It's just who they are.
Being around them makes you feel safe and understood,
like you can be yourself without fear of judgment.
It's rare to find people like that.
But when you do, you just know,
they're the kind of friends who make life a little bit brighter.

title: Your Last Everything
script_text:
I may not be your first love, your first kiss, or your first memory.
But I want to be your last everything.
Sometimes words fall short of how deeply you live inside my heart.
If I ever did anything right, it was the moment I chose you.
You don't just complete me. You remind me of who I was always meant to be.

title: I'm Not Born To Impress Others
script_text:
I don't care what others think about me.
I'm not born to impress others.
Every mask eventually wears you down.
Every honest soul faces criticism.
I'd rather be misunderstood for being real, than admired for being someone I'm not.

title: If I Don't Say It Enough
script_text:
If I don't say it enough, here's my reminder:
I love you. I cherish you. I support you.
I dream big for you.
I admire how you carry yourself.
And I couldn't be more thankful,
to be blessed with someone like you.

title: My Soul Yearns For A Soul Like My Own
script_text:
My soul yearns for a soul like my own.
In this crowded world, that might be the hardest thing to find.
Someone who carries a heart full of understanding,
and still knows what it means to feel alone.
Someone who understands the way I love.

title: The Greatest Truth Isn't Found In Words
script_text:
The greatest truth isn't found in people's words. It's found in their actions.
Sometimes people don't tell you the truth.
Maybe they're protecting you. Maybe they're protecting themselves.
Maybe they're hiding something you'll never know.
But no matter how carefully the truth is hidden, their actions always reveal what their words conceal.

title: Maybe You'll Be Seen As The Problem
script_text:
If someone makes you feel unvalued or hurt, don't argue.
Just step back and let silence speak what words can't.
Because the moment you point out their wrongs, you'll be seen as the problem.

title: What's Meant For You Will Find You
script_text:
What's meant for you will find you.
You don't have to rush to find it —
it'll come when your life has room for it.
And when it does,
you will finally understand why it couldn't have come sooner.
You weren't the person ready for it yet,
and your time was still becoming the right time.
So for now, try not to spend your whole life waiting for the next part,
when there is still something here that needs you to live it.

title: The Hardest Battles We Fight
script_text:
One of the hardest battles we fight is between what we know and what we feel.
The truth may be simple, but feelings have never obeyed logic.
That's what makes being human so difficult.

title: Love More
script_text:
If you love and get hurt, love more.
If you love more and hurt more, love even more.
If you love even more and hurt even more, love some more.
Until it hurts no more.

title: The Scary Thing About Distance
script_text:
The scary thing about distance is you don't know whether they'll miss you or forget you.
Maybe your name still crosses their mind before they fall asleep.
Or maybe they've already learned how to live without you.
That's what makes distance so painful.
Not the miles, but the silence, the uncertainty, and slowly becoming a memory to someone you still think about every day.

title: You're Making Memories Every Moment You're Living
script_text:
I think the most beautiful part of life
is that we never realize we're in the good days while we're living them.
You don't notice the last time your friends are all in the same room.
You don't know the last time you'll sit in your childhood home,
or hear a certain voice say your name.
You don't realize you'll miss the way your life felt before everything changed,
because it all just feels normal, routine, background noise,
until suddenly it's not.
Until those small, ordinary moments become the ones you ache for the most:
a late-night drive, a joke that made everyone laugh,
the silence that felt like safety, not emptiness.
And years from now, when you're flipping through old photos,
or hearing a song that used to mean something, you'll feel it:
that longing, that quiet realization,
that the best parts of life rarely announce themselves while they're happening.

title: What Is Love
script_text:
What is love?
It's giving someone the complete power to change your life.
It can bring hope, build you up, or sometimes destroy you completely.
The one who loves you can bring a smile to your face with the smallest things,
or break you entirely. Is this truly what love means?

title: Understanding Is Art
script_text:
Understanding is art, and not everyone is an artist.
Some paint with their eyes. Some paint with their ego.
Only a few paint with their heart.
The greatest works are never hung on walls.
They live quietly inside people's hearts.

title: Your Biggest Competition Is Yourself
script_text:
Your competition isn't other people.
Your competition is yourself:
your procrastination, your ego, the food you're consuming,
the knowledge you ignore,
the behavior you're nurturing, and what you're trying to improve at.
Compete against that.
If you're serious about change, you have to go through uncomfortable situations.
Stop trying to dodge the process.
It's the only way to grow.

title: Questions For Your Mother
script_text:
Five questions to ask your mother while you still can.
What did you want to become before you had me?
What's a moment you're quietly proud of me for?
What's something you gave up for us that we never noticed?
And what's one thing you want me to always remember, after you're gone?

title: We Suffer More In Imagination
script_text:
We suffer more in imagination than in reality.
We live inside our heads all the time.
It doesn't matter what the reality actually is.
The problem is we overthink everything.
Most of our pain doesn't come from what happens, but from what we imagine might happen.

title: Once You Decide You Want A Good Life
script_text:
Once you decide you want a good life,
the universe will start moving things for you to have it.
The people you need will appear, the healing you need will happen.
The doors you need open will unlock, but not till you decide.
Once you truly, sincerely decide, miracles will happen.

title: Your Days Will Get Better
script_text:
Just a reminder: if tomorrow is rough,
I'll sit here and say the same thing again.
It can get better.

title: I Love You With My Soul
script_text:
Rumi said, I love you neither with my heart, nor with my mind.
Just in case the heart might stop, the mind can forget.
I love you with my soul, soul never stops, or forgets.

title: He Breaks For Love Only Once
script_text:
A legend says a man truly breaks for love only once.
After that light goes out, he spends his life chasing its reflection in the faces of strangers.
He may search for her in everyone he meets.
But the deepest part of his heart stays locked in a past he can never return to.

title: Until My Last Breath
script_text:
In this journey we call life, we face so many different paths and choices.
But in every single moment, you are the one I choose.
So many things in my life might be uncertain,
but one thing is very clear.
I will keep choosing you and loving you until my very last breath.

title: You Are More Than The Worst Moment You Replay
script_text:
You are a whole person.
You are not a dark thought,
a conflicting emotion, a rash decision, a difficult relationship,
or any other single thing you have felt, said, thought, done, or been part of.
You are the combination of so many happenings,
both within and outside your control.
Please don't judge who you are, or who you can be,
by any incomplete image of yourself.
You are more than that.
You always were, and you always will be.

title: You Loved Me Anyway
script_text:
When I thought I didn't deserve love, you loved me anyway.
When all I knew was darkness, you brought me light.
When I said I was broken, you healed things you didn't break.
When I struggled to love myself, you loved me quietly.

title: Why That Happens Every Time
script_text:
I forgive people easily. I trust people easily.
I forget the bad things they did easily.
I always believe they'll be different this time.
I keep giving chances they never deserve, and I see the good in people, even when they show me the worst.
And somehow, I end up being the one who gets hurt, every single time.

title: Thank You For Loving Me In A Way I Didn't Know I Deserved
script_text:
Thank you for loving me in a way I didn't know I deserved.
I was trapped in a cycle of self-doubt until you broke it.
My days were a monotony of gray skies and silent rooms.
You breathed life into the emptiness and filled it with meaning.
Thank you for showing me that even the parts of me I had long forgotten,
could be loved.

title: The Heart Needs More Time
script_text:
Sometimes the heart needs more time to accept what the mind already knows.
The mind moves on the day it understands.
The heart moves on the day it stops hoping.
And between those two days, a person lives an entire life, pretending to be fine.

title: Your Wound Is Not Your Fault
script_text:
Your wound is not your fault, but your healing is your responsibility.
No one can rewrite your past, but you can decide how your story continues.
Heal, so the pain ends with you, not with the people you love.

title: The Only Way To Impress Me
script_text:
The only way to impress me is by being a good person.
I don't care what you have, what you wear, where you live, or what you drive.
I just have deep respect for people with pure hearts and good intentions.

title: You Were Always Enough
script_text:
Sometimes I think of you.
Not always, but enough.
You were here, then you weren't.
I wonder if you still remember.
It's quiet now, but the rain still pours,
a vibrating silence.
I never asked why, but I never had to.
I already knew what we had, what we lost,
and maybe what never was.
Time moves fast when it's running away,
taking you further from me.
It doesn't make it easier not to say it.
But doesn't it still linger,
the words neither of us said, though we both knew.
It's just a quiet, stifling solitude.

title: Let People Be Exactly Who They Are
script_text:
The beginning of love is letting people be exactly who they are, not shaping them,
not fixing them into a version that makes us comfortable.
Because the moment we try to remake someone in our own image,
we stop loving them for who they are,
and start loving only the reflection of ourselves we see in them.
Real love doesn't demand a transformation.
It offers acceptance.

title: You Meet The People You're Meant To Meet
script_text:
There is a legend that says you meet the people you're meant to meet.
Not by accident, not by chance, but by something your soul agreed to keep.
Some will come to heal you.
Some will come to break you.
But the ones who stay through both are the ones written in your heart.

title: I Still Believe In Us
script_text:
I still hope it's you and me in the end.
No matter how much has changed, or how many different paths life has led us down,
a part of me still believes in us.
It isn't just a wish. It's something I'm holding onto with everything I have.
My feelings for you never faded, and my heart still knows you're the only one who belongs by my side.

title: What Would Life Even Be Without You In It
script_text:
What would life even be without you in it?
It's strange to even think of now,
because loving you feels like the only life I've known.
I didn't realize how essential you became to me,
how easily my days shaped themselves around you.
My heart wasn't hoping or waiting,
yet somehow you arrived precisely when my soul needed clarity.
I am drawn toward you helplessly,
my soul recognizing nothing else but the promise in your eyes.
Life without you would mean days stripped of wonder,
nights emptied of hope.
I don't know exactly how to say it,
but life feels simpler knowing you're in it.
I guess that's just what you do:
make everything matter without even trying.
So I don't wonder about life without you anymore.
I only wonder how soon I can see you again.

title: What Love Feels Like
script_text:
If someone asked me what love feels like, I'd simply point to us.
With you, love isn't just a feeling.
It's the way time forgets to move when we're together.
It's the way my heart finds its way home in your presence.
And the way every dream I've quietly held somehow made room for you.

title: Your Best Chapter Is Still Waiting
script_text:
If you're strong enough to fall in love and give everything you have,
you're strong enough to let it all go.
Strong enough to pick up your pieces and start over.
Because the end of one story is never the end of your story.
Your best chapter is still waiting to be written.

title: I Don't Always Know The Perfect Thing To Say
script_text:
I don't always know the perfect thing to say,
but here's what I do know.
I'll show up for you.
Not just when things feel easy,
but when days get complicated, and you need someone who won't leave.
I'll pay attention to the things that matter.

title: He Was Just Doing His Best
script_text:
As you grow older, you begin to understand.
Your father was just a man, trying his best with what he knew.
He put your needs before his own.
He traded some of his dreams for the dreams he had for you.
He was living life for the first time too.

title: Life Has Taught Me
script_text:
Life has taught me, you can't decide how loyal someone will be.
Treating people with love and respect doesn't guarantee they'll return it.
Caring deeply for someone doesn't mean they'll care for you the same way.
The saddest truth is, the people closest to you can become the ones you feel safest keeping your distance from.

title: Sharing A Life Is Different From Standing Beside Someone
script_text:
I keep thinking about how the best relationships are built
from two people bringing things back to each other:
stories from their day, their deepest thoughts, their excitement when they see you.
Their victories become part of your day.
Their favorite places become places you care about too.
And you realize that sharing a life with someone
is different from simply standing beside them.
It's not about what the other person can do for you.
It's about what's there between you two, when everything else is stripped away.

title: Maybe You'll Be Seen As The Problem
script_text:
If someone makes you feel unvalued or hurt, don't argue.
Just step back and let silence speak what words can't.
Because the moment you point out their wrongs, you'll be seen as the problem.

title: The Journey
script_text:
There is a legend that says, if you get on the wrong train, get off at the nearest station.
The longer it takes you to leave, the more expensive the return trip becomes.
Every stop you stay past your peace is a cost you'll have to pay back.
So is this really only about trains?

title: More Than Words Can Hold
script_text:
I didn't fall in love with just your smile.
I fell for your voice, the way it softens when you speak to me.
I fell for your laugh, the one that brightens even my darkest days.
I fell in love with how you love me, gently, deeply, completely.
It's who you are that stole my heart, and I love you more than words can hold.

title: You're Not Just Someone I Love
script_text:
You're not just someone I love.
You're the embodiment of everything love means to me.
Your way of loving is a world apart from what I've known.
Being with you gives me a sense of belonging I've never found in anyone else.
It's almost scary how much you truly know me.
You have the ability to see beyond my silence,
to connect with what I'm feeling without me needing to speak,
to make me feel like I belong before I even ask for it.
You express your love in a way nobody else does.
It's in the way you support my dreams.
If I fail, your belief in me still lifts me higher than I ever imagined possible.
You never hesitate, through my ups and my downs.

title: Why Do They Hurt Me
script_text:
I spent so much time trying to understand why people hurt me.
I kept searching for reasons for their distance, their inconsistency.
The way they could walk away so easily without looking back.
But eventually I realized, I was giving kindness to people who never noticed how deeply they were breaking my heart.

title: True People Won't Need Convincing
script_text:
It hurts when your biggest effort is ignored, and your smallest mistake is judged.
People often remember one mistake, and forget a hundred sacrifices.
Don't waste your life trying to prove yourself to everyone.
Peace begins the moment you stop seeking everyone's approval.
The people who truly matter never needed convincing.

title: I Can't Think Of Any Greater Happiness Than To Be With You
script_text:
Franz Kafka said,
I can't think of any greater happiness than to be with you all the time.

title: As Adults We Understand Villains
script_text:
As kids, we love the heroes.
But as adults, we understand the villains.
Life teaches us that people aren't simply good or bad.
Sometimes the villain is just someone who got tired of being hurt,
someone who stopped explaining themselves, someone who finally chose themselves after being forgotten.

title: Sometimes You Just Have To Accept It
script_text:
Sometimes you just have to accept the situation.
Understand that it's okay. It happens. It's life.
Not every ending needs an explanation.
Not every loss deserves another chance.
Some chapters are only meant to teach, not to stay.
And one day, you'll thank life for what it didn't let you keep.

title: Lost With You
script_text:
Lost with you in you and without you.
Before you, after you, somehow, still around you.
Not by chance, not by choice, but by a love that never learned to leave.

title: Life Does Not Begin After Everything Gets Fixed
script_text:
People learn this too late in life.
You can keep waiting for everything to line up,
and not notice how much of your actual life is passing while you wait.
The day in front of you may not look like the life you pictured,
but it is still your life.
It still has good things in it.
It still has chances to dream, to create, to explore, to step outside,
to feel like you are here, instead of always waiting for somewhere else.
Life does not begin after everything gets fixed.
It begins on the day you keep trying to skip.

title: Once You Decide You Want A Good Life
script_text:
Once you decide you want a good life,
the universe will start moving things for you to have it.
The people you need will appear, the healing you need will happen.
The doors you need open will unlock, but not till you decide.
Once you truly, sincerely decide, miracles will happen.

title: Freedom Or Loneliness
I Chose To Stay
script_text:
I can't force you to love me, because love was never meant to be forced.
It has to come from your own heart.
But there's one thing I need you to know.
I will always be here, not because I have to, but because I chose to.
No matter how much time passes, somewhere inside my heart, a part of me is still waiting for you.

title: Being Alone And Feeling Alone Are Not The Same Thing
script_text:
When you were alone, and you actually felt alone,
you didn't let it overcome your mind.
You didn't let it consume your willingness to try again.
You didn't give up, and you didn't lose hope.
You may not be able to control everything that happens in life,
but what you can do is let go of the pressure to be perfect.
You were never supposed to be anything more than who you wanted to be.

title: Soulmates Recognize Each Other
script_text:
They say soulmates recognize each other instantly.
And I think that's why I felt so comfortable from the start.
I didn't need time to understand how much you meant to me.
Because my heart already knew, and it always did.

title: A Soul Your Own Has Always Known
script_text:
There is a legend that says when you meet your soulmate,
you'll feel a sudden sense of calm and peace,
as if you've finally come home after a very long journey.
And in their eyes, you'll recognize a soul your own has always known.

title: I'll Always Be Your Biggest Supporter
script_text:
I will always be your biggest supporter,
and I'll be there for you, always.
I want you to win at life,
reach all your dreams,
and become exactly who you want to be.

title: Find Your Happy Place
script_text:
In the wrong place, even your very best will never feel like enough.
But in the right place, your mere presence will be celebrated.
The same person can feel ordinary in one place, and extraordinary in another.

title: Never Get Too Attached
script_text:
Never get too attached to anyone who doesn't feel the same about you.
Because one-sided expectations can quietly destroy you.
Some people become your whole world, while you remain just a chapter in theirs.
So choose wisely. Choose yourself.

title: A Lot Of Things Made Sense
script_text:
I read a quote that said, Observe, but don't absorb.
Love, but don't depend.
Want, but don't need.
Feel, but don't dwell.
Give, but don't expect.
Speak, but don't hurt.
And suddenly, a lot of things made sense.

title: Keep Trying, Keep Moving
script_text:
I hope you know:
you are going to have days where you get it right,
and days where your head feels a few steps behind you.
You will forget things.
You will speak too fast.
You will change.
And over time you might not fit in where you used to.
You will outgrow old versions of yourself, again and again.
But none of that means you're behind.
It means you are here, trying.
And trying is enough.

title: The Only Way To Impress Me
script_text:
The only way to impress me is by being a good person.
I don't care what you have, what you wear, where you live, or what you drive.
I just have deep respect for people with pure hearts and good intentions.

title: Faith
script_text:
Please don't give up on us.
What we have means more to me than words can explain.
I know life isn't always easy, but I'm still trying my best for us.
We might have our issues, but my feelings for you are completely real.
Even when everything else feels uncertain, the one thing I still have absolute faith in is us.

title: Fortunate To Be With You
script_text:
You are the most beautiful person I've ever seen.
You are the strongest person I know.
You are the kindest person I've ever met.
You are the brightest light I've ever found.
I feel so fortunate to have the chance to be with you.

title: You Matter Way More Than You Think
script_text:
In case you haven't heard it in a while, I hope you know this.
Your life matters more than you think.
Your kindness reaches farther than you know,
and there are things only you can bring into this world.
Most people can keep going when life is easy.
Real strength shows up on the days you have every reason to stop,
but you take one more step anyway.
Trust yourself more than the things you cannot control.
Everything around you can change, and you'll still find a way forward.
Whatever you keep feeding will keep growing.
Keep feeding the hurt, and it will keep asking for more of your life.
Keep feeding what you've learned,
and one day you'll notice the hurt no longer has the same hold on you.
Don't mistake your time alone for loneliness.
There are days when your own company gives you more,
than a crowded room ever could.

title: A Love That Feels Real
script_text:
I don't need a perfect relationship.
I just want one that feels real and safe.
No lies, no cheating, no breaking up over every little fight.
If we argue, we talk it through. If life gets hard, we face it together.
We don't walk away. We stay. That's the kind of love I want.

title: You Feel Like A Part Of Me
script_text:
I wasn't looking for you when I met you.
But now, with you, it feels like a part of me always wanted this.
My heart stopped searching for anything else,
the moment it found you.

title: I'll Go Anywhere With You
script_text:
We don't have to make sense to anyone else,
as long as we make sense to each other.
When you ask where I'm going, I say:
wherever you're going.

title: I'm Just Kinder To Myself
script_text:
I don't chase people anymore. I chase peace.
If you stay, I'm grateful. If you leave, I'm still peaceful.
Because I finally learned, my worth isn't proven by how hard I'm willing to suffer to be loved.
I'm not cold.
I'm just kinder to myself.

title: The Only Moment You Can Shape
script_text:
No amount of regret rewrites yesterday.
No amount of worry controls tomorrow.
No guilt can undo what's already happened.
No overthinking has ever brought peace.
The only moment you can shape is this one.
Live it with intention. Make it beautiful.

title: Lovers Don't Finally Meet Somewhere
script_text:
Rumi said, The minute I heard my first love story, I started looking for you.
Not knowing how blind that was.
Lovers don't finally meet somewhere.
They're in each other all along.
What seems like a beginning is a revelation.
What seems like a meeting is recognition.

title: Your Anxiety Is Lying To You
script_text:
Your anxiety is lying to you.
The hesitation to heal comes from your anxiety,
feeding off the comfort of your current state,
trapped in a loop of replaying doubts you told yourself not to believe.
3 a.m. ceilings will flood your mind with disorienting comfort, and keep you in that hurt.
I know it's wearing you down.
Things can't get better in the same place where everything went wrong.
You'll be burdened with memories you'd rather forget.
The soul always knows when to let go, but the mind resists it.
Excuses and self-sabotaging words tell your emotions you're supposed to feel this way.
Don't get stuck there.
Years will pass, and your body will still hold that stress inside, if you don't let it go.
If there's a sun behind the clouds,
then there is happiness somewhere behind your doubts.

title: Truth Or Illusion
script_text:
Dostoevsky said,
perhaps it is better to suffer and know the truth than to be happy in a delusion.
But Franz Kafka said, I would rather keep my illusions,
for they are often kinder than the truth.
So the question is, do you want the truth?
Or do you want the illusion?

title: In This Life, You Will Realize
script_text:
In this life, you'll realize there's a purpose for every person you meet.
Some will test you, some will use you.
Some will teach you, and some will bring out the best in you.
A single choice can change your entire life.

title: Isn't It Strange
script_text:
Isn't it strange?
You are not the same person you once were.
Too much has changed. Too much had to.
So don't expect from yourself what you once embodied.
That version of you no longer exists. Maybe what you lost shaped you, and what you buried set you free.

title: The Lessons Remain
script_text:
The memories may fade, but the lessons remain.
The faces blur.
The voices soften.
But the weight of what we learned stays with us,
even when we think we've left them behind.
There are things we never forget,
because the painful moments teach us more than the happiest ones.

title: We Deserve This
script_text:
This chapter of our story is called, we deserve this.
Life hasn't been gentle to either of us, and we've both carried scars from choices we once made.
But somehow, life still brought us to each other for a reason.
Now we're learning what real love feels like.
So when you see us smiling, let us smile. We deserve this.

title: Soulmates Don't Meet By Accident
script_text:
Soulmates don't meet by accident.
They meet because you both needed each other without knowing it,
because something in both of you was missing,
that only the other could bring.
Everything you don't have, they do.
And everything they don't have, you do.
Soulmates don't come to give you everything.
They come to remind you what it feels like to be whole.
They meet because something unexplainable wants them to,
because the world feels less like chance and more like purpose,
when you find the person who makes it all feel right.

title: Fluent In Hiding What I Feel
script_text:
Because I carry it well, doesn't mean it's not heavy.
I've simply become fluent in the language of pretending nothing hurts, when everything does.
I make it look effortless,
because falling apart was never an option.

title: We All Want Someone Who Will Be There
script_text:
The truth is, we all want someone who would drop what they're doing if you truly needed them.
The person who keeps believing in you on days when you're struggling to see it yourself.
The person who has spent years showing up in ways that have become so familiar,
that you almost forget how rare it is.
And maybe that's when it finally sinks in,
not when someone does one big thing,
but when you stop and realize how many times they've been there.
Some people leave fingerprints all over your life,
just by caring about you consistently.
And when you really think about it,
that's a pretty incredible thing.

title: Lost With You
script_text:
Lost with you in you and without you.
Before you, after you, somehow, still around you.
Not by chance, not by choice, but by a love that never learned to leave.

title: Always Be Ready
script_text:
Always be ready to survive alone.
Some people suddenly change.
Today you're important to them, tomorrow you might be nothing.
Sometimes they only held you for their own benefit.
That's the ultimate truth of life.

title: I Can't Lie, I Miss You
script_text:
I can't lie, I miss you more with each passing day.
Your absence leaves a void nothing else can fill.
I miss the way you make me feel so loved and special.
I miss our conversations, your laughter, the comfort of knowing you're near.
Life feels a bit off without you, and until we're together again, know you're always in my heart.

title: You Are My Peace
script_text:
You are my peace.
You are my choice.
And you are my favorite place to rest my soul.

title: Let Me Remind You
script_text:
Let me remind you, I never want to lose you.
Life feels softer, brighter, and more beautiful with you in it.
You became the kind of person my heart feels safe with.
What I feel for you could never be explained with simple words.
No matter what life puts us through, I hope we always find our way back to each other.

title: But Do You Know Why I Love You?
script_text:
But do you know why I love you?
Because you never stop caring about me.
Because when we hug, you hug me so tight, like you never want to let go.
I love you because, from early on, I saw how our paths were meant to grow together.
Because you've made an impression on my life that will last an eternity.
I love you because you're always everything I need,
and you show me everything you need from me.
Because we think the same things at the same time.
I love you because you hate shallow conversation,
because we can have our long talks about things most people don't care to explore.
I love you because you could be invisible,
and you'd still be the most beautiful person I've ever come across.

title: Remember The Lesson
script_text:
Forget the past, but remember the lesson.
Let go of what hurts you, but never forget what it taught you.
Not every loss is a failure. Some are just directions.
Learn from it. But don't let it define you.

title: That's Life
script_text:
Imagine reading a book with no way to turn back the page.
How carefully would you read it?
That's life.
Every moment passes once.
Every word leaves a mark.
So choose what matters before it becomes a memory.

title: Rumi Said: How Can Love Be Endless?
script_text:
Rumi said, if you are in love with the moon,
it is because you never stay for long.
The night turned to me and said:
it is not my fault, I never see the sun.
How can I know that love is endless?

title: A Lot Of Things Made Sense
script_text:
I read a quote that said, Observe, but don't absorb.
Love, but don't depend.
Want, but don't need.
Feel, but don't dwell.
Give, but don't expect.
Speak, but don't hurt.
And suddenly, a lot of things made sense.

title: The Past Is Done
script_text:
Accept what happened. The past is done.
You can't go back and change it, no matter how much you want to.
What you can do is stop letting it control your present.
Accept it, and learn from it.
Don't let the past be your whole story. Let it be just one chapter.

title: All Of Me
script_text:
I hope you know there isn't anyone who gets my attention the way you do.
I'm all in for you.
There isn't anyone who can keep me up all night, thinking about them the entire day,
the way that I do for you.

title: Which One Did You Need To Hear?
script_text:
Pay attention, but don't let every little thing stay with you.
Notice the mood, but don't let it decide how the rest of your day goes.
Catch the lie, but don't waste another week waiting for the truth to show up.
Feel the shift, but don't let one bad moment speak for everything else.
Care about people, but don't start living their life instead of your own.
Help when you can, but not when helping turns into overextending yourself.
Say what you need to say,
but don't keep explaining yourself to people who already made up their mind.
Forgive, but don't keep walking back into the same situation hoping it ends differently.
Leave before one bad day turns into another month.

title: Drawn To You
script_text:
I got addicted to you so quietly, drawn to you in ways I still can't explain.
Every single day, you're in my mind.
When night falls and the world turns quiet, my mind doesn't.
It fills with thoughts of you.
You're the last wish hidden inside my heart.

title: Love More Until It Hurts No More
script_text:
Shakespeare said:
if you love and get hurt, love more.
If you love more and hurt more, love even more.
If you love even more and get hurt even more,
love some more, until it hurts no more.

title: Keep Building, Someone Is Waiting
script_text:
No matter how isolated or lonely you feel,
keep doing your work with honesty and quiet dedication.
Some battles are meant to be fought alone. Some chapters can only be written alone.
Someone out there is waiting to meet the person you're becoming.

title: Without Changing A Single Petal
script_text:
You can be the prettiest rose ever.
But if they like lilies, it wouldn't matter.
So don't question your beauty.
Some people simply can't appreciate what was never meant for them.
You'll be someone's favorite flower, without changing a single petal.

title: You Make Me Feel Loved In Every Way
script_text:
Some people make you feel loved by what they say.
Some people make you feel loved when they stay.
And you make me feel loved in every way.

title: Lovers Don't Finally Meet Somewhere
script_text:
Rumi said, The minute I heard my first love story, I started looking for you.
Not knowing how blind that was.
Lovers don't finally meet somewhere.
They're in each other all along.
What seems like a beginning is a revelation.
What seems like a meeting is recognition.

title: This Is My Promise
script_text:
Dear love, I may not be your first love, but I promise to be your last.
I promise to bring back the smile that faded from your face long ago.
I promise to fill your world with happiness once again.
No matter what storms come our way,
I will be with you forever.

title: A Deeper Love
script_text:
Real love happens in two moments.
First, you fall for who they appear to be, the charm, the smile, the feeling.
Then the truth unfolds. You see their flaws, their past, their struggles.
If you choose to stay, to understand, to love them as they are,
that's not attraction anymore. That's a deeper love, the kind that lasts.

title: You Make The World Feel Like Background Noise
script_text:
I love you in a way that makes the rest of the world feel like background noise.
You are the part of my life that makes the rest feel worth living.
You are my peace.
Love is simple when it's real, and I want simple with you.
I will show up when it counts, even if it seems small,
because that's how love lasts.
There is nothing I want more than to keep making this work with you.

title: Losing Everything
script_text:
If you feel like you're losing everything, remember.
Trees lose their leaves every year, yet they still stand there.
Waiting quietly for better days to come.
So if life feels empty right now, maybe you're just making space.
For something beautiful to grow again.

title: I Think About You In The Middle Of Good Days
script_text:
I love you because I think of you all the time.
I think about you in the middle of good days,
when something happens and you're the first person I wish could have seen it,
when I'm already surrounded by people I care about,
and part of me is still looking for you.
That's when I understood: it wasn't about needing someone to make life better.
It was about wanting the life I already had to include you.
And if you ever wonder whether I noticed the little things, I do.
The way your thoughts wander halfway through a story.
The way you remember things I forgot I told you.
The way a normal day feels different, the moment I get to share it with you.
I love all of it.

title: Change What Surrounds You
script_text:
I read once that you can't always change the people around you,
but you can change who you choose to be around.
And when I finally understood that,
everything made sense.

title: Look At Yourself And Remember Me
script_text:
Rumi said, You have no idea how hard I've looked for a gift to bring you.
Nothing seemed right.
What's the point of bringing gold to a gold mine or water to the ocean?
Everything I came up with was like taking spices to the Orient.
It's no good giving my heart and my soul because you already have these.
So I've brought you a mirror.
Look at yourself and remember me.

title: Remember What Nietzsche Said
script_text:
If you feel like no one understands you,
just remember what Nietzsche said:
the higher we soar, the smaller we appear to those who cannot fly.
Every deep thinker is more afraid of being understood,
than of being misunderstood.

title: The Next Page
script_text:
Your next move matters.
More than your last mistake.
The past can teach you, but it cannot define you.
What happens next is still in your hands.
Don't let one bad chapter convince you the story is over.
The next page could change everything.

title: Our Kind Of Love
script_text:
Do you know the most beautiful thing about our love?
It happened so purely, I never even imagined it in my dreams.
We didn't plan this love, and that's exactly why it's so special.
No rules, no boundaries, just two hearts coming together naturally.
It's more than love. It's peace. It's home.

title: Unconditional
script_text:
Can love truly be unconditional?
I believe yes.
Because unconditional love isn't a transaction. It's a sanctuary.
It's the rare, brave choice to see someone's deepest shadows and shattered pieces,
yet decide to stay and love them anyway.

title: A Japanese Legend Once Said
script_text:
A Japanese legend once said,
everyone has three faces.
The first face you show to the world.
The second face you show to your close friends and your family.
The third face, you never show anyone.
It is so rare to find someone of true understanding.
I know they say the first love is the sweetest,
but that first cut is the deepest.
Love is not about how many days, months, or years you have been together.
Love is about how much you love each other every single day.
And if you don't feel beautiful,
remember that your face is the face of who you loved most in your past life.

title: The Scary Thing About Distance
script_text:
The scary thing about distance is you don't know whether they'll miss you or forget you.
Maybe your name still crosses their mind before they fall asleep.
Or maybe they've already learned how to live without you.
That's what makes distance so painful.
Not the miles, but the silence, the uncertainty, and slowly becoming a memory to someone you still think about every day.

title: Life Becomes Easier Once You Understand This
script_text:
Life becomes easier once you understand,
that your perspective shapes your reality far more than circumstances ever will.
Your life does not need to make sense to anyone but you.
Others are not living your story. You are.
Growth is realizing you can admire someone else's journey,
without feeling behind in your own.
You did not come this far only to judge yourself through someone else's lens.
The world will always have expectations.
But remember, you are here to achieve no one's dreams but your own.

title: You Might Already Be Too Late
script_text:
I was too tired to explain, so I chose silence.
You kept asking what was wrong. I kept saying nothing.
You heard my words. You never heard my silence.
You wanted an explanation. I wanted to be understood.
By the time you finally understand me, it might already be too late.

title: Roses Are Not Always Red
script_text:
Roses are not always red, and violets are not always blue.
The people who say they love you, are not always the ones who do.
Goodbye is not always the end, and forever is not always true.
Sometimes the hardest part of love is accepting, I was not meant for you.

title: Every Life Is Temporary, But Its Impact Can Be Timeless
script_text:
Someone once told me,
what you don't know can't hurt you,
but it can't grow you either.
We long for simplicity,
yet create complexity to avoid truth.
Every person is a mirror,
reflecting something you've yet to face in yourself.
The more you cling to certainty, the more fragile you become.
Love is the one risk worth taking, repeatedly.
Every life is temporary,
but the impact of it can be timeless.

title: That's Life
script_text:
Imagine reading a book with no way to turn back the page.
How carefully would you read it?
That's life.
Every moment passes once.
Every word leaves a mark.
So choose what matters before it becomes a memory.

title: Love Is About Effort
script_text:
Love isn't just about what's comfortable for you.
It's about learning the language of the person you choose.
It takes effort, patience, and emotional maturity.
It won't always be easy.
Real love blooms when both people learn to love each other, not just themselves.

title: I Felt Peace
script_text:
I didn't fall for you because I wanted a relationship.
I fell for you because, for the first time in forever, I felt peace.
Like I was finally home.
I fell for your smile, the way you made my heart laugh,
and the way you never let me wonder if I was wanted.

title: Tiny Reminders For Heavy Days
script_text:
Tiny reminders for heavy days:
you do not have to solve your whole life before tonight ends.
Small progress still changes a life over time.
Your mind sounds harshest when you are exhausted —
that's a sign you need rest.
Missing one day does not erase the person you have been becoming.
People carry more than they explain out loud.
A rough season can still lead somewhere good.
Sometimes what looks like it's going wrong,
is actually leading you to the place meant for you.

title: Until My Last Breath
script_text:
In this journey we call life, we face so many different paths and choices.
But in every single moment, you are the one I choose.
So many things in my life might be uncertain,
but one thing is very clear.
I will keep choosing you and loving you until my very last breath.

title: You Are Enough As You Are
script_text:
You are already enough,
in many ways you have not even recognized yet.
The most important relationship you will ever have
is with the person who looks back at you in the mirror.
Appreciate yourself the way you appreciate a beautiful view,
patiently, and without judgment.
Learn to celebrate the person you have become,
without apologizing for who you once were.
Every step toward the unknown is a step away from the place you have outgrown.
Even the tallest trees began as seeds buried in darkness.
You find yourself not by searching, but by living.
Do not spend half your life searching outside,
for what was within you all along.
To appreciate life is to notice the ordinary and call it beautiful.
Do not just plan your future.
Romanticize the steps it takes to get there.

title: I'm Not Born To Impress Others
script_text:
I don't care what others think about me.
I'm not born to impress others.
Every mask eventually wears you down.
Every honest soul faces criticism.
I'd rather be misunderstood for being real, than admired for being someone I'm not.

title: Real Eyes Realize Real Lies
script_text:
Real eyes realize real lies.
Wise minds recognize disguise signs.
Pure hearts prioritize true ties.
False smiles often hide dark sides.
Time flies, exposing every disguise.
And the deepest scars come from trusted lies.

title: Some People Make You Feel Loved
script_text:
The one thing that will always make me feel loved,
is knowing that through anything, you'll be there, standing by my side.
Knowing I can count on you makes me feel so loved and cared for,
because I've never had to reach far to find you.
You're the one who will always meet me halfway.
Time may change our faces,
but your presence will outlast eternity.
And even as the world rearranges itself around us,
I would still recognize your soul.
I think of all the things I could say,
but nothing explains it better than the peace I feel when it's just us.
Like warmth without needing the sun,
trust without needing a promise,
peace without needing silence,
and joy without a reason.

title: Without Changing A Single Petal
script_text:
You can be the prettiest rose ever.
But if they like lilies, it wouldn't matter.
So don't question your beauty.
Some people simply can't appreciate what was never meant for them.
You'll be someone's favorite flower, without changing a single petal.

title: The Train
script_text:
Life is just a journey on a train, with a pair of travelers at every window.
Sometimes someone stays right beside you for the whole ride.
Sometimes they step off along the way.
But if destiny ever seats me next to you,
let's be pleasant travelers. It's such a short journey.

title: Complete Yourself
script_text:
A soulmate is not someone who completes you.
They're someone who encourages you to complete yourself.
They understand and love you despite your flaws, because they don't define you by them.
They help guide you to your true potential, your genuine self,
because they recognize what an amazing person you already are.

title: Your Future Is Being Built By What You Do Today
script_text:
Your future is being built by what you do today,
not what you plan to do someday.
Some progress is so gradual you don't notice it until you look back.
Remember, you can be proud of yourself before you reach the finish line.

title: I Still Believe In Us
script_text:
I still hope it's you and me in the end.
No matter how much has changed, or how many different paths life has led us down,
a part of me still believes in us.
It isn't just a wish. It's something I'm holding onto with everything I have.
My feelings for you never faded, and my heart still knows you're the only one who belongs by my side.

title: The Greatest Truth Isn't Found In Words
script_text:
The greatest truth isn't found in people's words. It's found in their actions.
Sometimes people don't tell you the truth.
Maybe they're protecting you. Maybe they're protecting themselves.
Maybe they're hiding something you'll never know.
But no matter how carefully the truth is hidden, their actions always reveal what their words conceal.

title: Do You Know Why Real Love Is Rare
script_text:
Do you know why real love is rare?
Because it's tested by distance, by miscommunication, by timing, by life.
But if two souls still choose each other again and again, despite the chaos,
that's not just love.
That's unbreakable.

title: You Did Good Today
script_text:
You did good today. Really good.
You might not see it.
You might think it was just another day, but it wasn't.
Every step you took today was a step forward, no matter how small.
You faced challenges, you overcame obstacles,
and you kept moving. Remember, every effort counts.
Every bit of progress matters.
You're building a better tomorrow with every action you take today.
The struggles you faced, they're just stepping stones,
leading you to greater heights.
You're stronger than you realize,
more capable than you give yourself credit for.
Be proud of yourself.
You're doing the work, making things happen.

title: Look At Yourself And Remember Me
script_text:
Rumi said, You have no idea how hard I've looked for a gift to bring you.
Nothing seemed right.
What's the point of bringing gold to a gold mine or water to the ocean?
Everything I came up with was like taking spices to the Orient.
It's no good giving my heart and my soul because you already have these.
So I've brought you a mirror.
Look at yourself and remember me.

title: Hope
script_text:
I hope you know, distance never separates two hearts that really care.
Our memories span the miles, and in seconds we're there.
Whenever I start feeling sad because I miss you,
I remind myself how lucky I am to have someone so special to miss.

title: Take Care Of Your Soul
script_text:
Be with someone who takes care of you.
Not just materially, but your soul, your well-being, your heart.
Someone who sees all of you, and still chooses to stay.
That's the kind of care worth waiting for.

title: More Than Words Can Hold
script_text:
I didn't fall in love with just your smile.
I fell for your voice, the way it softens when you speak to me.
I fell for your laugh, the one that brightens even my darkest days.
I fell in love with how you love me, gently, deeply, completely.
It's who you are that stole my heart, and I love you more than words can hold.

title: Understanding Is Art
script_text:
Understanding is art, and not everyone is an artist.
